2607.11980.title: LP Mining with LP2Graph: A Use Case for Railway Rescheduling
2607.11980.paper_summary: Like many optimization-driven domains, railway rescheduling relies on Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), yet the field's modeling knowledge is scattered across hundreds of papers in incompatible notations, and narrative surveys organize it subjectively: they classify models by vocabulary rather than by structure, and reproduce neither. We present LP Mining with LP2Graph, a method that mines the structure of published LP and MILP formulations into a reproducible dataset and an induced taxonomy. Its core, LP2Graph, represents each formulation admitted by its canonical grammar as a typed variable--equation graph derived from a single canonical model; once a source is extracted into that model, everything downstream is deterministic. Each source is parsed into this model, homologized, and clustered bottom-up (over variables, then constraints and the objective, then whole-model structure) and, separately, by application domain and solution approach; the resulting groups are labeled by a rule-seeded, self-updating classifier. We validate the representation rather than assume it: per-cluster representatives are regenerated as independent LaTeX and re-solved across CBC, HiGHS and Gurobi against the optimum reported in the source paper. The outcome is an objective, repeatable taxonomy of variables, constraints and model types: the principled foundation on which our raiLPminer line of automated railway-rescheduling model development builds.
2607.11980.paper_summary_zh: 像許多以優化為驅動的領域，鐵路重新排程依賴於混合整數線性規劃（MILP），然而該領域的建模知識散佈在數百篇不兼容的論文中，且敘述性調查以主觀方式組織這些知識：它們根據詞彙而非結構來分類模型，且都未能重現。我們提出了LP Mining與LP2Graph，一種將已發表的LP和MILP公式的結構挖掘成可重現數據集和誘導分類法的方法。其核心，LP2Graph，將每個由其典範語法所接受的公式表示為一個類型變數-方程圖，該圖源自單一典範模型；一旦來源被提取到該模型中，所有下游內容都是確定性的。每個來源被解析到這個模型中，同源化並自下而上進行聚類（先是變數，然後是約束和目標，最後是整個模型結構），並且分別按應用領域和解決方法進行聚類；所得到的組別由一個基於規則的自我更新分類器標記。我們驗證這種表示，而不是假設它：每個聚類的代表作為獨立的LaTeX重新生成，並在CBC、HiGHS和Gurobi中重新求解，以對比來源論文中報告的最佳解。結果是一個客觀、可重複的變數、約束和模型類型的分類法：這是我們的raiLPminer自動化鐵路重新排程模型開發所建立的原則基礎。
